correctness.rationale: For a matched pair, each vertex has utility u2=1-q(1-p); an isolate has u0=1-q; and each triangle vertex has u3=1-q(1-p/2)^2. Thus W(T_n)-W(M_n)=3u3-2u2-u0=q(p-3p^2/4)>0. The source’s AM-GM argument bounds every graph’s average utility above by u2, while M_n has average utility at least (n-1)u2/n. These give the two stated bounds with all parameter restrictions explicit.
